name: Lokalise WRITE - Realchecker FE AI pre-translation by tag (reusable)
description: AI pre-translation of Realchecker FE keys by TAG: style guide (Drive) + distilled rules + glossary + TM + key descriptions. Writes descriptions (if empty) + only empty targets, unverified + AI_TO_REVIEW. MODE check/write.

parameters.jsCode:
const g = $('Gate').all().map(function (i) { return i.json; });
return [{ json: { results: $input.all().map(function (r, i) { const b = r.json.body || {}; return { iso: (g[i] || {}).iso, sent: (g[i] || {}).n, status: r.json.statusCode, written: (b.keys || []).length, errors: b.errors || b.error || null }; }) } }];
